# Psychwire

> Psychwire offers flexible, evidence-based online training courses for mental health professionals taught by world-leading experts in therapy modalities.

Psychwire provides continuing education and professional development through online courses in evidence-based therapeutic approaches including DBT, CBT, ACT, EFT, EMDR, and Motivational Interviewing. The platform features instruction from renowned experts like Marsha Linehan, Russ Harris, Sue Johnson, and the founders of Motivational Interviewing.

## Key Topics

- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy)
- EFT (Emotionally Focused Therapy)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- Motivational Interviewing
- Evidence-Based Practice
- Clinical Skills Training
- Continuing Education Credits
- Trauma Treatment
- Attachment Science
- Marsha Linehan
- Russ Harris
- Sue Johnson
- Professional Development

## Flagship Therapy Programs

- [DBT Online Courses with Dr Marsha Linehan](https://psychwire.com/linehan): DBT training courses with Marsha Linehan on clinical skills
- [ACT Training with Dr Russ Harris](https://psychwire.com/harris): ACT training with Dr Russ Harris for flexible therapeutic skills
- [Motivational Interviewing Training](https://psychwire.com/motivational-interviewing): MI training from founders William Miller & Stephen Rollnick
- [Online CBT Training](https://psychwire.com/cbt): CBT training for anxiety, depression, and trauma treatment
- [Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) Online Courses](https://psychwire.com/sue-johnson): EFT courses with Dr Sue Johnson on attachment science
- [Advanced EMDR Courses with the EMDR Institute](https://psychwire.com/emdr): Advanced EMDR courses from Francine Shapiro's EMDR Institute

## Foundational & Specialized Courses

- [DBT Foundational](https://psychwire.com/linehan/dbt-foundational): Foundational DBT course for clinicians preparing for DBT teams
- [DBT Skills Training with Dr. Marsha Linehan](https://psychwire.com/linehan/dbt-skills): DBT skills training covering four modules with Marsha Linehan
- [ACT for Beginners with Dr Russ Harris](https://psychwire.com/harris/act-beginners): Beginner ACT course with Dr Russ Harris on foundational skills
- [CBT Foundational](https://psychwire.com/cbt/cbt-foundational): Foundational CBT course on core principles and therapeutic techniques
- [Motivational Interviewing - Foundational](https://psychwire.com/motivational-interviewing/mi-foundational): Foundational MI course with William Miller & Stephen Rollnick
- [EFT: Attachment Science in Practice](https://psychwire.com/sue-johnson/eft-attachment-science): EFT course on attachment theory with Sue Johnson
- [EMDR for Attachment Injuries](https://psychwire.com/emdr/emdr-for-attachment-injuries): Advanced EMDR course on attachment injuries and developmental trauma
- [Unified Protocol Online Course](https://psychwire.com/other-courses/unified-protocol): Unified Protocol transdiagnostic treatment course with David Barlow
- [Compassion Focused Therapy](https://psychwire.com/other-courses/compassion-focused): Compassion Focused Therapy course on shame and emotional distress

## Additional Training Programs

- [Online Courses for Mental Health Professionals](https://psychwire.com/other-courses): Catalog of courses including CFT, SFBT, and Unified Protocol
- [Learn AMSR with the Zero Suicide Institute](https://psychwire.com/zsi): Zero Suicide Institute AMSR training for suicide risk assessment
